'''Neva Kee''' was a [[Xamster]] [[Gender|male]] [[Podracer (profession)|podracer]] [[pilot]] who participated in the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing|podrace]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] during the [[Standard year|year]] [[32 BBY]]. During the second lap of the race, Kee flew off course to find a shortcut and disappeared, never to be seen again. Speculation arose that his [[podracer]] might have crashed and that Kee was then captured by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the Hutt]], but no firm evidence of his fate was ever found.

==Biography==
A [[Gender|male]] member of the [[Xamster]] [[species]], Neva Kee was a [[Podracer (profession)|podracer]] [[pilot]]<ref name="EYNTK" /> who hailed from the [[planet]] [[Xagobah]].<ref name="CL 2016" /> During the [[Standard year|year]] [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas-Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> Kee was present on the planet [[Tatooine]] in order to participate in the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing|podrace]]. Flying a [[Color|purple]], inverted, Y-shaped [[podracer]], Kee started on the nearside position of the last row, behind the seventeen other competitors. After the initial ceremonies, race host [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the Hutt]] officially began the Boonta.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

[[File:Neva_Kee_flag.jpg|left|thumb|Neva's flag]]
Kee fared poorly from the get-go, and was quickly passed by [[Anakin Skywalker]], who had actually stalled on the starting grid and got a late start.<ref name="TPM" /> During the second lap, Kee flew off of the [[Mos Espa podrace circuit|course]] in search of a shortcut, only to never be seen again.<ref name="EYNTK" /> Following his disappearance, [[Law enforcement agency|police]] [[inspector]] [[Tanivos Exantor Divo]] acquired a [[hologram]] image depicting Jabba the [[Hutt]] paying [[bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing]] near the crash site of Kee's podracer, while two of Jabba's henchmen pulled Kee out of the wreckage. All identifying authentimarks were scrubbed from the hologram, making the authenticity of the images unclear. Divo also developed a theory that [[Farwan & Glott]], the original manufacturers of Kee's podracer, had hired Sing so that they could acquire the racer's customization secrets, which Kee had never shared.<ref name="Star Wars: Scum and Villainy">''[[Star Wars: Scum and Villainy: Case Files on the Galaxy's Most Notorious]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Neva Kee was a blue and off-white-skinned Xamster with orange [[eye]]s.<ref name="FC" /> During the Boonta Eve Classic, Kee attempted to cheat by finding an off-course shortcut, a maneuver that caused his disappearance.<ref name="EYNTK" /> Kee also notably never shared his custom modification secrets for his podracer.<ref name="Star Wars: Scum and Villainy" />

==Equipment==
[[File:NevaKeePodracer-SWCTP.png|thumb|right|250px|Neva Kee's unconventional podracer]]
Neva Kee flew a [[Neva Kee's Custom Podracer|podracer]] that was a solid, rigid unit as opposed to a traditional podracer with a [[cockpit]] tethered to two [[engine]]s. Instead of the cockpit being behind the engines, it was instead placed in front of them.<ref name="TPM" /> He made special secret modifications to his podracer, but never shared them.<ref name="Star Wars: Scum and Villainy" /> Neva's flag was blue with two ribbons above the flag colored black and white, and one ribbon below the flag which was colored a light blue. 

==Behind the scenes==
Neva Kee was created for and appeared in the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> The [[2022]] [[StarWars.com]] article "[[Star Wars Inside Intel|''Star Wars'' Inside Intel: Podracing]]" uses gender-neutral pronouns in reference to Kee despite him having been long established to be male.<ref name="Inside Intel">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-inside-intel-podracing|text=''Star Wars'' Inside Intel: Podracing|int=Star Wars Inside Intel}}</ref>

In the revised [[Star Wars: Episode I The Beginning|rough draft]] of the script for ''The Phantom Menace'', Neva Kee is said to be from [[Aquilae (Aquilae system)|Aquilae]].<ref name="DB2">{{DB|organization|boontapodrace|Boonta Eve Classic Podracers}}</ref>
